definitions.explanation: A narrow, raised beam used in gymnastics. The gymnast performs acrobatic moves, jumps, and poses while balancing on the beam. Also found in school gym equipment.

examples.japanese: {平均台|へいきんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk on the balance beam.

examples.japanese: {平均台|へいきんだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I fell off the balance beam.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}{競技|きょうぎ}→体操競技：26394_taisoukyougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平均台|へいきんだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She won the gold medal on the balance beam at the Olympic gymnastics competition.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧ (balance/average) + {台|だい} (platform/stand). In competitive gymnastics, the balance beam is one of the four apparatus events for women. The beam is 10 cm wide and 125 cm off the ground.
